data.desc: Replimune Group, Inc., headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, was founded in 2015 with the mission to transform cancer treatment by pioneering the development of novel oncolytic immunotherapies. TUDRIQEV is the company's first commercially available product. Replimune's proprietary RPx platform is based on a potent HSV-1 backbone intended to maximize immunogenic cell death and induce a systemic anti-tumor immune response.
